next_gate: freeze Batch-B top-family process references, then Batch-C electroweak/triboson and Batch-D zbbbb, before luminosity and global weight construction

reference_policy.five_processes: authoritative inclusive 13 TeV reference with the already-frozen branching convention

production_banner_value_comparison.purpose: allow only binary floating-point serialization noise while rejecting scientifically meaningful source-value changes

reference_policy.vbf_hbb: LO generator-fiducial production-banner cross section with exact generator cuts embedded; external H->bb factor applied once
reference_policy.vbf_hh4b: LO generator-fiducial production-banner cross section with exact generator cuts embedded; no external H->bb factor

vbf_fallback_reason.vbf_hbb: paired acceptance was numerically usable, but a direct production-fiducial reference removes the remaining inclusive process-scope ambiguity and is consistent with both production campaigns
vbf_fallback_reason.vbf_hh4b: two independent fresh paired integrations did not meet the precision/reproduction gates; the exact production banners are campaign-consistent and are therefore frozen as the faithful generator-fiducial normalization instead of forcing an unvalidated inclusive acceptance correction
